The property P described is that for every positive tolerance (ε), there exists a positive delta (δ) that can depend on both the tolerance (ε) and the specific point (x) being considered, such that if the distance between two points is less than δ, their function values are within ε of each other. This is the definition of pointwise continuity. In contrast, uniform continuity requires that δ depends only on ε and be independent of the point x.

<ANSWER>POINTWISE</ANSWER>
